transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we get into the readout, I want to flag a clinical-data privacy issue that I believe needs to be addressed before this agreement is approved. The current draft permits publication of project results, but from a privacy and clinical regulatory standpoint, we need to ensure that any permitted publication is conditioned on de-identification and that patient-level data is prohibited from external publication. I confirmed this position with the product lead and privacy office in a working session yesterday. I'll go ahead and put that on the record now.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to put a critical IP finding on the record. I reviewed the university's master research agreement and the controlling schedule they supplied overnight. Background patents U1, U2, and U3 are licensed to the company only for noncommercial academic use. The final agreement must exclude those three patents from any commercial license and require separate written university consent before any commercial use. I have not yet incorporated this into the draft or circulated the finding prior to this meeting.
transcript.speaker: A2

decisions.background_ip_treatment: Background patents U1, U2, and U3 must be excluded from any commercial license grant; they are licensed to the company only for noncommercial academic use under the university's master research agreement and controlling schedule.

commitments.detail: Revise the draft agreement to exclude background patents U1, U2, and U3 from any commercial license and to require separate written university consent before any commercial use of those patents.
Revise the publication provisions to condition any permitted publication on de-identification of data and to prohibit publication of patient-level data externally.
